tools.name: video_list_blocks
tools.title: Video: list blocks
tools.description: List video blocks by job, visual language, energy, screenshot needs, kind and size, including defaults, props schema, timing and poster URLs. Free metadata.

tools.name: video_search_blocks

tools.description: Search video blocks by name, tags, job, visual language and category. Returns usable refs, props schemas and posters, without source retrieval fees.

tools.name: video_create_project
tools.title: Video: create project
tools.description: Create an editable video. For a product or launch request, supply an authored initial blocks (kit ops) sequence with real on-screen product copy; the title does not replace block defaults. Use a template slug, single blockRef or empty canvas when requested. Returns projectId, editorUrl and rev. Verify the draft with video_get_doc, then open its fresh editorUrl in the host's in-app browser.

tools.name: video_get_doc
tools.title: Video: get doc
tools.description: Read the compact video document, rev and the user's current editor selection/frame. Read this before planning edits; hand-set fields in mine are preserved unless force explicitly names them.

tools.name: video_apply_ops
tools.title: Video: apply ops

tools.name: video_propose_variants
tools.title: Video: propose variants
tools.description: Propose against baseRev without changing the video. Choose exactly one: variants (2 to 4 general alternatives), or groups (up to 20 existing block scenes, exactly 3 distinct style options per scene). Scene groups use only scene-local set_prop presentation fields and preserve the same block, content, palette, fonts, logos, audio, captions and timeline. An empty ops option keeps the current style. Groups normalize touched style keys to absolute values so independent scene choices can be mixed and changed later. Returns complete groups, detailed dropped-group errors, or a conflict with the fresh document.

tools.name: video_upload_asset
tools.title: Video: upload asset
tools.description: Request a presigned PUT for a local logo, screenshot, video or audio. PUT the bytes to uploadUrl with the returned contentType, then call video_finalize_asset. Storage limits and ownership checks apply.

tools.name: video_finalize_asset
tools.title: Video: finalize asset
tools.description: Verify a completed PUT and add the owned asset to the project through CAS at baseRev. Returns assetId and the new rev, or a conflict; call again with the fresh rev to attach the already uploaded asset.

tools.name: video_snapshot
tools.title: Video: snapshot
tools.description: Render a real PNG of frame N at the given project rev and size. Returns an image for visual review without a hosted LLM. A small hourly preview budget bounds renderer abuse.

tools.name: video_export
tools.title: Video: export
tools.description: Export the saved video at rev through the existing renderer and plan quota. Returns jobs or blocked with the reason. Poll video_export_status until ready; cached exports are free.

tools.name: video_export_status
tools.title: Video: export status
tools.description: Get the authorized project's exports and progress. Ready jobs include a short-lived MP4 download URL.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search 21st (components, themes, templates)
tools.description: Search the 21st.dev catalog across ALL entity types - React/shadcn components, themes, and templates - returning lightweight metadata ONLY (name, description, preview image, author, url/install, id, and price for templates). Use `type` to scope to one kind, or 'all' (default) to search everything. FREE. Retrieval differs by kind: for a component result call get_component with its `id` (that id is a demo id) for the PAID code; for a theme call get_theme with its `id` (a uuid) for the free CSS; templates have no code to fetch - open their `url`. NOTE: `author`/`mine`/`liked` bypass ranking and return a plain recency-ordered list (query/sort/tag/color are ignored when any of them is set); component listings via `mine`/`author` only ever show PUBLIC components - your own private/team components are discoverable via list_team_components, not search. Pass `runtime: 'remotion'` (optionally `kind`, `aspect`) to search 21st Video blocks, Remotion components for programmatic video; without it results are UI only. Returns plain data, no picker UI - use this for your own lookups. If the USER should see a visual list of options and pick one, use `search_picker` instead (identical params, same results, but renders an inline picker on hosts that support it).

tools.name: edit_take
tools.title: Apply deterministic edits to a take
tools.description: Apply free deterministic edits to an owned Sketch or Code take using stable target IDs from get_take.structure. Pull the take first and supply its exact version to avoid overwriting newer changes. Code supports literal JSX text, element styles, visibility, image URLs/alt, locks and static subtree duplication/moves/removal within one JSX tree. Remove physically deletes an unlocked static subtree and prunes its current notes; old saved versions remain intact. Clones get fresh source and DOM IDs. Dynamic JSX, handlers/imported components and unsupported global tokens require an explicit AI note; no paid fallback runs. Locked files and active generation are protected. Returns a confirmed saved version with zero credits; never invokes a paid fallback.

items.description: image/link require HTTP(S) url; take requires exact positive take/version and optional saved id; component requires author/component slug. Planned component intent additionally requires exact demoId, published reusable license/ACL and a saved unique part-targeted UUID note. Server binds references/stamps authors; planned never proves installation.

purpose.description: Editable saved part plan; requires a UUID note ID and exact part root target.

notes.description: Optional complete notes list. New notes get a server-stamped author. Use ops:[] for free notes-only saving. Existing IDs preserve authoritative author and status; refs bind exact immutable same-project versions.

media.description: Exact target override at widths up to 639px. Code requires a uniquely mounted static native element in the proven default App source; unsupported responsive source needs a note.

alt.description: Image only: plain alternative text. Omit to preserve; use an empty string for a decorative image. With no value, change only alt and preserve the saved src/srcset.

anchor.description: Existing saved destination address for move.

takeNotices.description: Exact saved-context metadata. response_prepared means server reply preparation, never client read or application. Missing infrastructure is unavailable, not zero.

tools.name: edit_profile
tools.title: Edit your 21st profile board
tools.description: Replace the caller's own 21st.dev public profile board (the bento layout at 21st.dev/@you). Owner-only - always writes YOUR account, there is no username argument. `blocks` is a FULL REPLACE (like `tags` on edit_component) - omitted blocks are dropped, so read the current board with get_profile first if you want to keep existing content. Pass `clear: true` instead of `blocks` to revert to the classic (non-bento) profile. The server auto-arranges blocks into a grid and validates every reference: `component` cards must be YOUR OWN public components (get their demoId from search with mine:true, or get_component), `library` cards must reference a public library owned by you or one of your teams, and `image` cards must point at a url returned by this account's own uploads (foreign image urls are dropped). Response includes `warnings` for anything dropped. Block vocabulary: {type:'component',demoId} shows a live component preview; {type:'ascii'|'template'|'theme'|'gradient',refId} references your published content; {type:'library',refId} links a personal or team library; {type:'social',url} is a link card; {type:'note',text} is a text card; {type:'hire'|'pro'|'support', headline?, body?, url?, email?, cta?} are profile CTA blocks; {type:'image',mediaUrl} shows a photo/GIF; {type:'divider'} splits the board into a new section. Every block accepts optional `w`/`h` (grid units, 1-3 wide / 1-2 tall).

blocks.description: Full replacement list of content blocks, top to bottom.

mediaUrl.description: image: a url returned by upload_profile_media (foreign urls are dropped).

clear.description: Revert to the classic profile (drops the saved board).

enabled.description: Explicitly show/hide the bento board without changing its content.

blocks.description: The saved semantic content blocks after validation/auto-arrange (empty after clear).

body.description: hire/pro/support: pitch text; may be absent.

cta.description: hire/pro/support: button label override; may be absent.

demoId.description: component: the demo id; may be absent.

email.description: hire: contact email; may be absent.

h.description: Height in grid units (1-2); may be absent.

headline.description: hire/pro/support: short title; may be absent.

mediaUrl.description: image: first-party media URL; may be absent.

refId.description: ascii/template/theme/gradient/library: referenced item id; may be absent.

text.description: note: the note's text; may be absent.

type.description: Block kind: component | social | hire | pro | support | note | image | divider | ascii | template | theme | gradient | library.

url.description: social/hire/pro/support: the link; may be absent.

w.description: Width in grid units (1-3); may be absent.

enabled.description: Whether the bento board is shown after the write.

warnings.description: Anything dropped or adjusted during validation (invalid refs, foreign image urls, etc.).

tools.name: upload_profile_media
tools.title: Upload a photo/GIF for your profile
tools.description: Upload an image (base64) to the caller's own 21st.dev media storage and get back a first-party url to use as an `image` block's `mediaUrl` in edit_profile. Accepts png/jpeg/gif/webp up to 5 MB as a base64 data: url (`data:image/png;base64,...`) - NOT a remote url to fetch; download the bytes yourself and pass them as base64.

dataUrl.description: A base64 data: url, e.g. data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0...

url.description: First-party URL of the uploaded image, usable as an image block's mediaUrl.

annotations.title: Upload a photo/GIF for your profile
